representation_fit.evidence: Brief job is explore over a multi-dimensional dataset with dimension switching as the core cognitive load. Initial screen is a pivot-style explorer: 8-dimension rail with per-value counts and mini-bars (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; source/app.js:239-286), projection surface with measure + breakdown selectors, distribution chart and record table (source/index.html:42-68); unbounded records represented by 1,280 inline rows with a 60-row cap plus hit count (source/app.js:20,376-407; source/data.js:115); the numeric dimension is binned so it joins categorical dimensions in one projection/filter model (source/data.js:117-149).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The projection surface (chart + record table) dominates the center at both viewports and the side panels exist solely to serve projection/filtering (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; source/index.html:31-89). No off-task content appears on the initial screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: the screen self-describes in one glance — header shows dataset name and 记录 1,280 · 维度 8 · 当前命中 1,280 (screenshots; source/app.js:224-237), with explicit interaction legends: 点名称＝投影 · 勾选值＝过滤 (source/index.html:36), 点击条形＝按该值过滤 (source/index.html:59), tray hint 归属维度 + 来源 · 逐条可回退 (source/index.html:75).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (projected dataset) is on screen at load, 0 steps. Dimension switch is 1 click on the rail name (source/app.js:495-499), filter toggle is 1 click via checkbox or bar (source/app.js:501-509), undo/redo/reset are permanently in the header (source/index.html:23-27). No modes, dialogs, or drill-in pages exist in source.

context_loss.evidence: Structurally engineered against context loss: projection switch never touches filters (source/app.js:113-135); same-dimension filters are excluded only from their own bars, cross-filters otherwise persist (source/app.js:61-70); record selection persists across projections and warns when excluded by filters (source/app.js:460-469); focus is restored after full innerHTML re-render via data-k keys (source/app.js:200-221); full command-pattern undo/redo (source/app.js:73-92).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Five permanent surfaces (header, dimension rail, projection surface, state tray, inspector) each map to the explore job, and high density is per-brief. Deduction: at load the inspector panel is an empty placeholder occupying roughly 40% of the right column (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; source/index.html:81-87), and fitting everything required 9.5-11.5px micro-labels (source/styles.css:89,123,143).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks). Corroborated in source: 12px checkboxes (source/styles.css:138), 20x20 tray revert buttons (source/styles.css:251-254), 20x24 expanders (source/styles.css:106-109), muted #858b9b 10.5px text on white (source/styles.css:7,89,143). Positives exist: :focus-visible outline (source/styles.css:36), aria-expanded/aria-pressed/aria-label and roles (source/app.js:263,345; source/index.html:23,33,42,72,81), Enter/Space row activation and Esc deselect (source/app.js:525-529,572) — but all three a11y checks still fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots are clean at 1280x860 and 1440x900. But 4 of 7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), a defect cluster implying a dedicated accessibility/type-scale rework pass.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 过滤/投影状态有归属且可回退 is fully addressed: every filter entry carries {id, dim, valueIdx, origin, at} (source/app.js:94-103); the tray lists each active filter/projection with badge, owning dimension, origin, and per-entry ✕ revert (source/app.js:410-454; screenshot right panel shows 生效状态 1 · 投影维度→区域 · 来源: 初始默认); projection revert via history stack (source/app.js:113-135,176-179); global undo/redo/reset (source/app.js:562-564); tray hover highlights the owning rail row (source/app.js:540-548).

defects_observed: Receipt check failures: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json; 3 pass / 4 fail / 1 warning, target_invalid false)
Contrast risk visible in source tokens: muted #858b9b on white and #9aa0b8 on dark header for 10-11.5px text (source/styles.css:7,53,57,89)
Sub-minimum target sizes: 12px filter checkboxes, 20x20 tray entry buttons, 20x24 dimension expanders (source/styles.css:138,251-254,106-109)
Type scale below common projected minimums: 9.5-11.5px chips/hints/counts (source/styles.css:89,123,143,162,247)
Base body font 12.5px (source/styles.css:29) consistent with the type.min_projected_size failure
Measurement summary contains 1 warning with no per-check attribution, so its nature cannot be verified
scores.overall_note: This package implements the explore × dimensional-space brief with a pivot-style single-page explorer whose representation fits the shape bundle almost exactly: eight dimensions (one numeric, binned to unify with categorical ones), per-value cross-filtered counts, projection + breakdown selectors, and an unbounded-record table capped at 60 rows with hit counts (source/data.js:115-149, source/app.js:20,367-408). The brief's success criterion — dimension switching must not reset cognition — is directly engineered: projection changes never touch filters, selection and focus survive re-renders, and every state change lands in an attributed, individually revertible tray plus global undo/redo, which also covers the acceptance seed verbatim (source/app.js:113-135,410-454). The initial screen requires zero navigation to act on and is unusually well self-labeled. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three a11y receipt checks fail plus minimum projected type size, consistent with a very dense 9.5-12.5px type scale and 12-24px targets, while the three layout/text checks pass and neither viewport shows visible layout defects — so the implied rework is an accessibility/type-scale pass, not a layout rebuild. Per the rubric, task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable here, and model-judged salience/understanding scores are proxies, not human measurements.
